mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which signals an impending economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.5), the economy is in an expansion phase, which supports corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.5, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 increases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below $470 billion signals weak consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 470.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which signals reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the monetary policy is restrictive, which dampens economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
